questions.question: What is RQWERTY?
questions.answer: RQWERTY is a free, guided touch-typing course on a standard QWERTY keyboard. Its 36 lessons cover letters, capitals, punctuation, numbers and longer mixed passages, with four optional code lessons.

questions.question: What makes Relaxed QWERTY different?
questions.answer: Relaxed QWERTY keeps the usual QWERTY layout and stable finger assignments, while allowing the hands to move. Z uses the left ring finger, X the left middle, C the left index and B the right index.

questions.question: How do I finish a lesson?
questions.answer: Each lesson has a short, visible sequence of exercises. Every accuracy pass moves you forward; the last exercise completes the lesson. Chapter passages require 97% accuracy. Speed is never a gate.

questions.question: How do keepsakes work?
questions.answer: Each chapter gives you one permanent illustrated keepsake. It remembers a capability you practised and opens that chapter’s passage for replay.

questions.question: Where is my progress saved?
questions.answer: Relaxed QWERTY stores progress in this browser, or your account when signed in. An account is free and optional; it syncs progress across devices.

questions.question: Who makes RQWERTY?
questions.answer: RQWERTY is made by Strange Systems, the studio behind CropASAP and No Ceremony.
